summary: Stream decoder for a byte-pair command list. Reads a big-endian length from two stream bytes, then iterates (length - 2)/2 command pairs. Each pair is an ID byte and a value byte that are reported through the state dispatcher: state 78 with a parameterized dispatch, state 26 when the ID is >= 32, and state 27 when the low nibble of the value exceeds the high nibble. Values are stored nibble-split into the this+0xCA / this+0xDA byte arrays for IDs below 16, and as a full byte at this+0xDA+ID for IDs 16..31. The byte stream is transparently refilled through the stream object's refill function whenever its remaining count reaches zero.

local_names.v2: current read pointer inside the stream buffer
local_names.v16: remaining byte count in the stream buffer
local_names.v13: first stream byte promoted to a big-endian high byte (byte << 8)
local_names.v14: 16-bit length field assembled from the two stream bytes
local_names.v12: pair ID byte (index of the target command field)
local_names.v11: pair value byte (payload stored into the field arrays)

operations.description: If the stream's remaining byte count is zero, call the refill function stored at stream+0xC; abort with return 0 when the refill fails
Assemble a big-endian 16-bit length from the first two stream bytes (first byte shifted into the high byte, second byte added low); the pair-consumption loop runs while length - 2 stays positive
Consume (ID, value) byte pairs while the remaining length is positive, decrementing by 2 per pair and refilling the stream through stream+0xC whenever the remaining count hits zero
Report the pair through the dispatcher: write state 78 to obj+0x14, the ID byte to obj+0x18 and the value byte to obj+0x1C
Parameterized dispatch of the pair through the second vtable entry (obj+0x4) with argument 1
IDs >= 32 re-dispatch the value through the state-dispatcher vtable (obj+0x0) with state 26 instead of the storage path
IDs below 16 store the value as separate nibbles in the two field arrays (low nibble at this+0xCA+ID, high nibble at this+0xDA+ID); IDs 16..31 store the full byte at this+0xDA+ID
When the low nibble is greater than the high nibble, re-dispatch through the state-dispatcher vtable (obj+0x0) with state 27 to resolve the nibble ordering
After the loop, write the final consumed read pointer and remaining count back into the stream read-state struct at this+0x14
Return 1 on a successful parse; return 0 when a stream refill fails mid-parse; invoked by CommandDispatchStateMachine (0x0051126A)
